So on older versions you need to use stack searchbar but it can have placement that puts it in the footer location? Maybe these should be unified somehow...

> but it can have placement that puts it in the footer location?

What is an example of this? I haven't seen the search bar in footer on iOS 18

> Maybe these should be unified somehow.

What do you think about API like this:
- search bar config stays the same as it used to be -> `<Stack.Header><Stack.SearchBar .../></Stack.Header>`
- if someone wants to display the search bar in toolbar (iOS 26+) they need to add `<Toolbar.SearchBarPlacement asButton />` to toolbar in order to configure where it should be in toolbar

So on this:
```tsx
export function Page(){
return ....
<Stack.Header>
<Stack.SearchBar ... />
</Stack.Header>
<Toolbar>
<Toolbar.SearchBarPlacement />
</Toolbar>
}
```

will render in navbar on ios 18 and in toolbar on ios 26
